Anya: Quick question  I was at a client dinner in Lisbon and the restaurant charged a 10 EUR corkage fee when we opened a bottle. They said they can't run the bar on the corpcard and asked me to pay the corkage personally. Receipt attached (itemized). Is corkage reimbursable?

Tom (Finance): Corkage is typically treated as an incidental to a business meal. Reimbursable if the meal is business-related and the amount is reasonable. Please submit as "Meals - Client Entertainment" and attach the itemized receipt + a note with client name.

Carlos (Sales): It was a client dinner (Atlantech team). I approve retro for this expense. @Anya please tag me on the expense so ops knows it's client-facing.

Mei (People Ops): Policy note: client entertainment up to 150 EUR/person should be manager-approved; incidental corkage under 15 EUR is auto-approvable when manager confirms. VAT on corkage is generally non-reclaimable in Portugal.

Anya: Submitted EXP-5301 with receipt: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/2012345678-corkage.pdf Note: client Atlantech, manager Carlos approved.

ExpenseBot: EXP-5301 received and queued for review. Estimated processing time: 3 business days.

Tom (Finance): Reviewed and approved. We'll reimburse to payroll unless you choose bank transfer. GL mapping: corkage -> Travel/Meals - Misc; VAT flagged no-reclaim.

Anya: Thanks all, closing thread.
